# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Design System & Color Policy
- **Monotone Dominant (Black, White, Gray)**:
  - Base theme is strictly Black, White, and Gray.
  - Minimalist, premium, and clean editorial presentation.
  - Avoid colorful decorations or unapproved accents.
- **Strategic Red Accent ("ここぞという時の赤")**:
  - Red (`#e11d48` / `#dc2626`) is reserved solely for high-priority CTA actions or critical badges.
  - Do not overuse red on body text, standard links, or minor UI details.

## Gallery Formatting Rules
- Never add unnecessary headings (e.g. "PHOTO GALLERY", "全○点", "公式プレスキットギャラリー").
- Never add bracketed prefixes in captions (e.g. "【エクステリア】", "【インテリア】").
- Minimal presentation: photos, counter (`1 / 10`), clean captions.
